author: Benjamin Geoffroy Dit Belhumeur
title: Children's Picture Book Illustrator Wanted: First Book of a New Series
content:
Children's Picture Book Illustrator Wanted: First Book of a New Series

Belhumeur Books is looking for an illustrator for the first book in a new children's picture book series, and we want it to be the start of a long partnership, not a one-off gig. We have steady book work planned well beyond this first title: the right illustrator will have ongoing commissions for the foreseeable future.

The project: ~640 words, 14 full spreads + cover, 8.5" × 8.5" paperback. Warm, playful, family-centered, told entirely in first-person visuals. We're after soft, expressive, cinematic storytelling; classic picture-book charm with real emotional range.

Who we're looking for: An emerging illustrator ready to earn their first picture book credit, or add a strong title to an existing portfolio. You need to draw the same characters, animals, and settings again and again, different scenes, different angles, and keep them recognizable every time. Strong sequential storytelling across full spreads.

Pay: $3,000 flat for book one, in four $750 milestones (signing / approved thumbnails & character designs / approved finished illustrations / print-ready delivery).

Two shortlisted finalists each get $100 for a paid test.

Future books come with paid commissions and the opportunity to negotiate ongoing royalty participation.

Prominent cover and title-page credit.

Timeline:
Hire by November 1, 2026;
Thumbnails ~December 15;
Finished art ~February 1, 2027;
Print-ready ~March 1, 2027

To apply: Email belhumeur.books@gmail.com with your portfolio link, 3–5 samples showing the same characters across multiple scenes and angles plus sequential pages, a sentence or two about yourself, your availability, and confirmation your work is original and human-made (no generative AI).

author: Eden Garden Jewelry
title: We need an illustrator
content:
We need an illustrator. We can’t tell you why. Not yet

You’re the one if:
you design original characters, from first sketch to final art
you can do turnarounds, expression sheets and pose variations
anatomy is your strength
fantasy, flora, fauna and hybrid creatures feel like home
you draw bodies and skin tones of every kind
your work is hand-made, digital or traditional
you’re free in October 2026

It’s a bonus if you animate, tell stories in panels, or love Art Nouveau and folklore.

Paid commission. Your style. Your name on every post. NDA until launch.

To apply, email smm@edengardenjewelry.com or DM with your portfolio, 3 characters you love, and the creature you’ve always wanted to draw

author: Anonymous participant
title: Looking for a long-term artist for weekly character art
content:
(ENG/TAG OK!) LOOKING FOR A LONG-TERM ARTIST!

Hello! I'm an ASMR RP creator on YouTube based overseas, and I'm looking for a reliable long-term artist to work with on a weekly basis for thumbnails and videos! I'm currently working with a limited budget, so I'm hoping to find an artist whose rates are a good fit for ongoing weekly commissions!

I'm looking for:
* Weekly character art - 1x Simple rendered anime-style bust up or half body art of my OC per week (hopefully to be expanded to full body eventually once my income & budget increases!)
* Expression variations - Multiple facial expressions on the same art base - PSD file organized into separate layers for eyes/mouth/eyebrows/etc. for ability to mix & match
* Occasional additional elements - Small add-ons may be requested (such as a tear overlay, hand caressing the face, etc.). Additional compensation can be discussed

Ideally, I'd love to have each illustration to be completed within a week of providing the script + directions. However I am very happy to discuss a timeline that works best with both of us, as long as we can maintain a consistent weekly schedule ^^

Please only respond if you:
* Are over the age of 18
* Have read through this post all the way (please add ANY flower emoji to your reply)
* Can reliably commit to weekly commissions and deliver them on time!

If you're interested, please feel free to reply with your commission rates and relevant examples of your work! I will be reaching out via DM for further discussions :)

(You might have to check spam coz this is like a brand new account I made for anonymity LOL)
